title: Tweaking boss fight
author: HungryChokie
selftext:
I’ve been working on a card match memory game and recently introduced boss battles every 5th stage (only done 5 boss battles so far).

Considering the first one probably sets the tone I wanted to see others thoughts on it.

Is it too easy/hard and is it intuitive and easy to understand.

Basically you pair weapons to attack the boss but pairing other cards first gives you bonus damage (consecutive matches) so ideally you build your combo and attack but it’s not essential.

If you’d like to give it a go and give feedback that would be awesome! 

https://pareho.fun/
